title: Tool Spawning & Equipping Gotchas
summary: Tools move through containers automatically: Backpack → Character on equip, back on unequip. Giving tools means parenting to player.Backpack; 'equipped' scripts re-parent; tools without Handles misbehave.

explanation.whatItIs: Tools are nomadic: they live in StarterPack (template), get copied to Backpack, and re-parent into the Character while equipped — breaking cached paths.
explanation.whyItExists: Equipping physically welds the tool to the hand, so the object must move to where the hand is.
symptoms: Cached tool paths going nil after equip/unequip
Scripts inside tools running at unexpected times (Activated/Equipped)
'Tool doesn't appear' — parented to wrong container or player has no Backpack yet
explanation.fix: Give tools via player.Backpack: tool:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack. React to Equipped/Unequipped/Activated events instead of assuming location. Ensure a proper Handle.
tips: StarterPack contents copy to Backpack on spawn — server can add more anytime
Tool.Enabled=false for cooldowns (greyed out, not removable)
commonMistakes: Assuming script.Parent stays Backpack — it becomes the Character while equipped

examples.title: Granting a tool safely
examples.code:
-- Server Script (e.g., shop purchase):
local function grant(player, toolTemplate)
    local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack then return end   -- dead/spawning
    local copy = toolTemplate:Clone()
    copy.Parent = backpack            -- player will see it in inventory
end

-- Inside the tool's Script — react, don't assume:
local tool = script.Parent
tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
    print("In hand")
end)
tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    print("Clicked while equipped")
end)
